objective: Inventory all organizer train audio/text pairs and prepare non-lossy, leakage-aware inspection manifests; no training or decision-model inference
input: train/train.jsonl and train/audio only; no environment files
normalization: Unicode NFC then collapse Unicode whitespace to ASCII spaces and trim; preserve case, punctuation, digits, identifiers and wording; preserve original separately
tokenizer: pinned Gipformer bpe.model; require no unknown and exact decoded normalized text for training readiness; uppercase diagnostic only, no rewrites
groups: union request conversation, existing P9 lexical families, exact normalized casefold transcript, exact decoded PCM; protect all P9 validation and excluded components; assign remaining groups to dev by SHA256 seed 20261103, 10% threshold
duplicates: exact same decoded PCM and normalized text: keep first deterministic occurrence for split and flag duplicates; conflicting text on same PCM: exclude all; group before split
review: P32 ten flagged audio clips and all train_0999 clips; duration/transcript rate and clipping flags are heuristics, not truth; preserve existing attested reviews separately
speaker: group by speaker only when explicit trustworthy speaker ID exists; no inference from user profile or voice
acceptance: GO only if usable label-preserving training targets have no tokenizer unknowns or changed roundtrips and alignment/quality and split constraints are established; otherwise NO-GO
